svg.aria-label: Three mystery cards. Mystery 1, same century, opposite stories: in Japan people live longer than almost anywhere but the population is falling; in Niger women have about six to seven children on average and the population is growing fast. Why? Mystery 2, better cars, more CO2: a car today uses far less fuel per kilometre than in 1970, but total CO2 from road transport is several times higher. How? Mystery 3, rich but successful? 100 fossil fuel producers are responsible for 71% of industrial greenhouse gases since 1988, and many made huge profits. Were they successful?
